title: Audit & Authz Deployment: scope change log, compliance tests, and sign-off playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket captures clarified requirements, scope changes, test acceptance criteria, and a definitive sign-off checklist for Private / VPC deployments related to SSO (SAML), RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM key handling. The goal is to produce a verifiable, minimally-invasive onboarding surface for enterprise customers that require auditable evidence and operator-level controls.
background: Customers have repeatedly requested a one-stop acceptance artifact for private deployments that maps SSO/SAML configuration, RBAC mapping, KMS/HSM key custody, and audit retention into executable verification steps. Previous PRDs covered individual items; this consolidates those into a phased acceptance playbook with explicit scope deltas and test artifacts.
scope_changes: 1) Expanded audit-retention requirement from 1 year to configurable retention up to 7 years for enterprise contracts. 2) Added explicit KMS key escrow option for air-gapped/on-prem customers. 3) RBAC role-mapping now requires SAML attribute-based mapping and an automated reconciliation report. 4) Introduced operator access timebound sessions with HSM-backed signing for emergency actions.
requirements: - SAML: metadata exchange, signed assertions, audience restrictions, and SAML ReplayProtection must be implemented and testable in staging. - RBAC: support for role templates (Admin, Operator, Auditor, AppUser), attribute-based role assignment, and a reconciliation endpoint that produces CSV evidence. - Audit logs: immutable append-only logs, signed with KMIP/HSM keys, retention configurable per deployment, default 3 years, max 7 years. - KMS/HSM: customer key import, rotation policy (90 days), split-escrow option, and operator key usage audit trails. - Operational: runbooks for key rotation, breach response, and disaster recovery; automated smoke checks during upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: SAML federation in staging: metadata exchange with customer IdP, successful authentication for 3 distinct user personas, and assertion logs demonstrating expected attributes.
RBAC mapping: given a sample SAML assertion (provided by customer), the role-mapping engine assigns roles as documented; reconciliation CSV matches live assignments with zero unexplained mismatches.

Audit evidence: for a 7-day synthetic run, audit logs show append-only behavior, are signed with KMS keys, and can be exported to S3 with integrity checksum; retention metadata persisted in the control plane.
KMS/HSM: import a customer-wrapped root key and perform a forced rotation; verify key IDs change, signing operations succeed, and rotation events are logged and immutable.
Operator access control: a simulated emergency access request must require multi-approver workflow, create a timebound session, and emit operator actions to audit store with HSM-backed signatures.
Upgrade smoke test: perform a minor runtime upgrade in a staging private cluster with traffic split; no audit gaps observed and KV cache warmup completes within SLA window.
test_plan: Conformance tests: automated SAML conformance suite against customer IdP metadata (link to test harness).
RBAC integration test: end-to-end mapping test using customer assertion samples and reconciliation report generation (linked PR).
Audit export test: generate logs, run integrity check, and ingest into a simulated SIEM; verify searchability and retention tags.
KMS rotation test: script-driven key import and rotation using HSM emulator and live KMS; manual verification steps listed in runbook.
Chaos test: delete a control-plane node during rotation and verify failover retains audit continuity.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Staging validation with two pilot customers and internal security review. Phase 2: Limited customer rollouts (1–3) with dedicated SRE support and weekly evidence package deliveries. Phase 3: General availability with templated onboarding artifacts and self-serve checklist. Each phase requires completion of the sign-off checklist and an independent security reviewer approval.
signoff_checklist: Security: review SAML assertion logs and approve replay-protection configuration (security@example.com).
Infra/SRE: validate KMS import and rotation scripts in a mirrored environment and approve operations runbook.
Product: confirm RBAC templates match compliance requirements for the customer and validate reconciliation report format.
Legal/Privacy: confirm retention limits and data export controls align with contract language.
Customer Success: run onboarding dry-run with customer and confirm they can produce sample evidence within 48 hours.
Release Manager: verify upgrade smoke tests and sign off on rollback plan.
Final: consolidated evidence package (SAML metadata, RBAC CSV, audit export, KMS rotation log) uploaded to secure drive and linked in this ticket.
notes_and_decisions: - Decision 2026-02-12: Agree to support max 7-year retention behind an enterprise flag; this increases storage cost but required by customer contracts. - Decision 2026-02-25: Add split-escrow option for air-gapped customers; design doc linked. - Trade-off: enabling longer retention requires additional cataloging metadata; we will add cost-alpha tag in billing dashboard.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: KMS import process complexity for certain HSM vendors. Mitigation: provide vendor-specific runbooks and a validation script. Risk: SAML attribute variability across IdPs. Mitigation: create a mapping shim and fail-open detection for unmapped attributes.
